Container.Name: moneythistle
Container.Overview: MoneyThistle: a simple personal money manager in your browser. Accounts, register, bills, budget, reports, and automatic backups to a folder and to Nextcloud / WebDAV. The image is built locally on the server with unraid/install.sh (it is not on Docker Hub).
Container.Requires: Build the image first: copy the app folder to the server and run unraid/install.sh.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the web page (http://SERVER:PORT, also over Tailscale).

Config.Name: Backups folder
Config.Description: Local backup copies (can be a share, e.g. /mnt/user/backups/moneythistle).

Config.Name: App files
Config.Description: The MoneyThistle folder you copied to the server. Copy a newer version here, then use Settings, Restart MoneyThistle in the app.

Config.Name: First administrator user name
Config.Description: Used only on the very first start, to create the first sign-in. Everyone else is added under People in the app.

Config.Name: First administrator password
Config.Description: Used only on the very first start (8+ characters). Leave empty to create the first sign-in in the browser instead.

Config.Name: WebDAV backup address
Config.Description: Optional. e.g. https://cloud.example.com/remote.php/dav/files/USER/Backups/Money (can also be set in the app).

Config.Name: App addresses
Config.Description: Addresses shown at the bottom of the app, comma separated (e.g. http://tower:8080/,http://tower.tailnet.ts.net:8080/). Filled in by install.sh.

Config.Name: Shown: money data folder
Config.Description: Only shown in the app's Settings. Keep it the same as Money data.

Config.Name: Shown: backups folder
Config.Description: Only shown in the app's Settings. Keep it the same as Backups folder.

Config.Name: Shown: app files folder
Config.Description: Only shown in the app's Settings. Keep it the same as App files.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id that owns the files (Unraid nobody = 99).
